records.text:
# §A · ORIENTATION — the whole project in one page

> **Why this file is called GOOD-MORNING** *(Dave's framing — keep it, it explains the architecture)*
> **Memento.** Leonard has anterograde amnesia: every morning he reconstitutes himself from a record he
> built when he still remembered — Polaroids for working state, **tattoos for the facts he cannot afford
> to lose**. That is this project's operating model, not a metaphor for it. A session starts with no
> memory and rebuilds from artefacts.
>
> **The trust hierarchy is the tattoo/Polaroid distinction:** repo rules + runbooks + ledgers = tattoos
> (durable, survive any single rewrite) · `GOOD-MORNING` + `_LIVE-STATE` = Polaroids (working state,
> rewritten often) · the chat = gone by morning. **Never let a durable rule live only on a Polaroid.**
> *(Live example, 2026-07-22: this file said the tabs ruling was "NOT yet inscribed" — the ledger already
> carried R-D23 AND R-D24. The ledger was right. Read the ledger.)*
>
> **The real danger is not forgetting — it is confident false inscription.** Records carry provenance
> and confidence, not just content. Corrections get inscribed as loudly as the original claim. **Mark
> what was OBSERVED versus what was INFERRED.** The ritual stamps dates from `date`, never from belief.
> *(2026-07-22 afternoon instance: B-D7 was ruled in TWO beats — "shared 4%", reversed within the hour
> to pixel-true. BOTH are in the ledger, so the reversal can never read as agent drift.)*
>
> **The SECOND failure mode costs more: a stale READING of our own rules.** ⇒ **Before designing anything,
> CONSULT: `python3 knowledge/_consult.py "<what you're about to design>"`** (rules · rulings · assertions ·
> gates + where each bites). Runbook: `knowledge/_RUNBOOK-consult.md`. *(ds-009 CLOSED 2026-07-22: the
> corpus is now DISCOVERED — every `_proforma/_*-DECISIONS.md` indexes or the build fails.)*

> **STANDING SECTION — carry it into every handoff, from 2026-07-17 on.** At Dave's request:
> *"orientate a new starter — wider context helps."* New-starter style: assume the reader has no context.
> **Update it when the shape of the project changes, not every session — but never drop it, and never
> shorten it to a label.** *(Also step 2 of `_RUNBOOK-capture-ritual.md`; reachability-gated by
> `_validate_standing_instructions.py`.)*

## What Apollo is
A **governed design-system engine** for agentic UI generation. The bet: *generation is a commodity* — the value
is the layer around any generator. Two principles run through everything:
- **Retrieval, not recall.** Brand values are retrieved from token stores, so generated work can't drift off-brand.
  **Since ADR-0013 (built 2026-07-22) retrieval reaches RULES too:** organisms consume atoms' rule-blocks
  as generated partials — never re-type a sub-atom.
- **Verification = enforcement.** Judgment is encoded as **blocking gates**; "done" is withheld until they pass.
  If a rule isn't gated, assume it will be broken.

Tagline: **"lovable on rails."** Four phases: **Discover** → **Create** (what's being built now) → **Craft**
(the review-overlay docs ARE this) → **Dispatch**.

## ★ ONE token store · ONE baseline library · FOUR themes (R-D15 → ADR-0011 → ADR-0014 → ★ ADR-0013)
*Themes are **override sets at the semantic tier**; since ADR-0014 they carry **their own neutral primitive
ramps** through the **neutral DNA tier** (semantic roles alias `color/neutral/1–15`, never `color/mono/*`
directly; indices are SEMANTIC POSITIONS — SC remaps its anchor). **State mechanism is a THEME PROPERTY**
(registry `stateMechanism` + blocking snap gate). **★ Since ADR-0013, MOTION is a theme dial too (B-D7):**
`motion/press/{travel,darken}` — Mono carries the movement (pixel-true 2px), **Console inherits it**,
**Legacy + Supercharge zero it** (colour-only state feedback); tuning = a token edit, zero JS.
**Sibling pairs:** {Mono, Console} share neutrals/opacity/status/dataviz — Console FENCED (colour;
motion is inherited-not-fenced, flag if it should join); {Legacy, Supercharge} = structural siblings.*
The four themes (Dave's canonical order):
- **Apollo Legacy** — faithful reproduction of the existing HSBC system: brand red `#DB0011`, teals,
  `color/grey/*`. **AA-EXEMPT as-built (R-D24)**; explicit per-path overrides, no DNA tier, **no press movement**.
- **★ Apollo Mono** — the baseline we build NOW. "Very mono": colour ONLY in RAG status + dataviz.
  Neutral scale = `color/mono/1–15`; only red `#B92F1E` (status/RAG/dataviz). Carries the B-D7 press physics.
- **Apollo Console** — branded HSBC library. **LOCKED ≡ Mono** on neutrals/opacity/status/dataviz (fence);
  inherits Mono's motion; live divergence = rounded corners (radius overrides, values provisional).
- **Apollo Supercharge** — brand-uplift. **OWN warm ramp** `color/warm/1–15` (OBSERVED, Figma pull);
  states = COLOUR; **no press movement**; dark mode = provisional-agent, awaiting Dave.

## Where things live
```
knowledge/            THE ENGINE
  tokens/             DTCG token stores — the retrieval source
    colour.json       primitives: mono/1-15 · neutral/1-15 (DNA tier) · warm/1-15 (SC) · grey/* (Legacy)
    semantic-colour.json  roles alias color/neutral/* + rag/* + component tiers + $extensions.apollo.state
    motion.json       durations · easings · ★ press/{travel,darken} (B-D7 — the theme-dialable physics)
    themes/           the four override sets + _themes.json registry (stateMechanism · neutralRamp ·
                      siblingPairs · console fencedPaths · ★ Legacy/SC motion kills)
  ★ component-types.json  THE ADR-0013 REGISTRY — one file, both halves: component-type/<group>/<param>
                      tokens ($alias→semantic + cached $value) + $members (selector map) + $partials
                      (source atom · rootSelector · requires/matchValues/declarations · $manifestBinds)
  snippets/           64 gated reference components = CANON (40 + Phase-2's 24). Atoms carry
                      PARTIAL blocks; consumers carry generated AUTO-PARTIAL blocks (provenance-
                      commented, sync-gated). Multi-control members = :is() selector lists (wave-1
                      convention); mixed sizes = local --phys-size override
  ★ gen_component_partials.py  injects partials into consumers; --check = build gate; selftest 8 bites
  ★ _validate_partials.py      the re-implementation RATCHET (strict on members · census = accretion
                      worklist) → _PARTIALS-GATE.md
  canon/              canon.css (token spine · components · AUTO-THEMES cascade) + type.css (HAND-AUTHORED)
                      + generators (gen_canon_tokens · gen_theme_cascade · ★ gen_canon_components — now
                      IN the build: regenerate-always + determinism --check, ADR-0013 ruling 4)
  guidelines/         the rules, each {#id} + destiny tag; _rules-index.json (generated)
  _proforma/          Apollo Mono tranches T1–T9 + the decisions ledgers (near-canonical per ruling 3)
  _consult.py         "what governs X?" — RUN IT before designing (corpus now DISCOVERED, ds-009 closed)
  _validate_*.py      the gates — incl. _validate_state_snap.py (ADR-0014) + ★ _validate_partials.py
  gen_showroom.py     generates showroom/ — never hand-edit showroom
showroom/             THE LIBRARY, browsable: 64 harness pages + index w/ live count (#theme=… all four)
reviews/              review sheets — ★ AWAITING DAVE: SC-DARK-MODE-2026-07-22-v1(.REVIEW).html
notes/_receipts/      worker-receipt dir · notes/_briefs/ conductor briefs
_LIVE-STATE.md        LIVE / DEAD / OPEN / TARGETS — read second, always
```

  re-implementations; the census lists everyone else's (accrete from OBSERVED duplication, ruling 3).

On "read good morning", role is picked (Worker / Conductor / Solo) — **from Dave's opener line ONLY;
titles are labels.** ONE conductor = single writer for shared state; workers emit receipts to

reconstruct.** Pipeline VERIFIED WORKING 2026-07-23: headless-shell download + libs + real-HSBC-cut

> ## ★ PRIOR — 2026-07-27 (Mon **afternoon #9**, OPUS solo self-conducting, effort MAX — ★ **ds-019 WITHDRAWN WITH CAUSE: THERE IS NO OVERRIDING RULE, AND THERE NEVER WAS** · ★ **the defect was the INSTRUMENT — a computed value read in the SAME TASK as the class change is the PRE-transition value** · ★ **`oklab(0 0 0 / 0)` is an IN-FLIGHT INTERPOLATION, not a failed declaration** · ★ **the predecessor probe's control WAS WORKING and was overruled as a string artefact** · ★ **DV-D17's render-proof UNBLOCKED · Dave's screenshot question ANSWERED** · harness given a REPO HOME by Dave's ruling · build untouched **60/60 GREEN** · 🔴 ~63% by his "headline only" call): **A false defect spent one full session as canon, and the record was directing the next window to hunt a rule that does not exist.**
> - **★ ds-019 IS NOT A DEFECT.** `.dv-legrow.is-solo` **(0,2,0) at cascade index 4** beats `.dv-legrow` **(0,1,0) at index 3** — CDP `getMatchedStylesForNode`, no `!important`, no inline, no `attributesStyle`, no keyframes, **no `:is()`/`:where()` or `#cb4-legend li` rule.** Confirmed in **six contexts**: snippet @1180/@760 · showroom light pane @1180/@760 · showroom **dark** pane @1180/@760 (theme-tracks correctly — `--ink` `#FFFFFF`, 6% white). **The census that found only four `dv-legrow` selectors was right; the premise it answered was false.**
> - **★ THE MECHANISM, measured as a time series.** `.dv-legrow` carries `transition: border-color var(--ease), background var(--ease)` = **0.16s**. Before add: `rgb(225,225,225)` / `rgba(0,0,0,0)` · **t=0 same task: `rgb(225,225,225)` / `oklab(0 0 0 / 0)`** ← *exactly the pair ds-019 recorded as proof* · t≈50ms: `rgb(145,145,145)` / `oklab(0.217785 … / 0.0241082)` **(mid-interpolation)** · **t≈150ms+: `rgb(26,26,26)` = `--ink` ✓ / 6% ink ✓.** **It paints from ~160ms.**
> - **★ THE HARDEST PART: THE PREDECESSOR'S POSITIVE CONTROL WAS WORKING.** It saw `oklab(0 0 0 / 0)` differ from `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)` and passed — and those **genuinely are different states** (transitioning-transparent vs static-transparent). Session #8 diagnosed its own control as a string-comparison defect and **dismissed a true signal**. The string method was bad *and* its verdict was right. ⇒ **When a control fires unexpectedly, exhaust "it detected something real" BEFORE concluding it is broken.** Sibling of [[gate-narrows-its-own-rule]] and #7's stale suite — **the instrument present, correct-looking, and not measuring what it claimed** — except this one **got inscribed into the corpus as a defect and began directing work.**

Verbatim: *"I've gone with your recommendations but we should probably wrap up and do it in the next window."* **A2** = mint dataviz-tier `--data-control-*` equivalents (siblings of `--data-axis`/`--data-grid`/`--data-series-*`, which already live on chart scopes) · **B2** = label-led (disabled label goes recessive; disabled border returns to `--line`, matching enabled-resting — **accepted cost, ruled with it: the label then carries the whole distinction**) · **C2** = the wide gate (*a declaration referencing a custom property that resolves nowhere in its own scope is a build failure*), the `fail-loud-on-unknown` shape already ratified for `dv-vocab`. ⚠ **C3 (the affordance gate) was NOT rejected on merit — it was not selected**; it stays a live candidate because it catches a resolved-but-wrong ladder C2 cannot see.
- **⛔ STILL UNRULED AND MUST NOT BE INFERRED — THE RECESSIVE VALUE.** The doc offered `#9D9D9D` / `#808080` / `#B5B5B5` / `#6B6B6B` **explicitly as candidates and explicitly NOT as a recommendation** (derivation governance: value promotion is Dave's alone). `#9D9D9D` was only the page's pre-selected preview. **The light/dark pairing is equally unruled.** ⇒ **Enactment must put the value to him; it may not read it off the ledger.**
- **★★ THE SQUEEZE — the finding that produced CALL B and was not in the record.** The remedy the record implied (*"make the disabled border recessive"*) is **structurally impossible**: enabled-resting border = `var(--line)` `#E1E1E1` at **1.31:1**; disabled currently resolves to ink at **17.40:1** ⇒ **the dead control carries 13.3× the contrast of the live one.** Anything quieter than enabled is below the perceptible floor; anything equal erases the distinction. **No third value exists, so the border channel cannot carry this state.** The label channel can — enabled label is ink at maximum contrast, leaving the recessive-but-visible band **B-D4 already ruled acceptable.** ⇒ **channel is upstream of tier, not downstream.**

The prior entry's *"zero `:root`"* was true of `--border-disabled` only and got over-generalised to both. ⇒ **"promote to `:root`" is already the label token's state, and it is a source of defect.** (2) `--border-disabled` census **confirmed unchanged** — 29 declarations, ten `.cn-*` form scopes + SC/dark twins, zero chart scopes, zero `:root`. Both are ledgered, but they disagree, and it collides with the unruled recessive value.

## ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-27 (Mon **evening #10**, OPUS solo self-conducting, effort MAX — ★ **DV-D17 IS RENDER-PROVEN: the debt from three sessions is DISCHARGED** · ★ **the old acceptance test was one-sided — an assertion of an ABSENCE, which a full revert also satisfies** · ★ **ds-018 RE-VERIFIED on a clean instrument and it STANDS — and the states are INVERTED, which is worse than reported** · build **60/60 GREEN**) — "A proof that only checks a thing is gone is satisfied by a revert; the missing half was proving it was ever there."

- **★★ DV-D17 — ENACTED · DOM-PROVEN · ✅ RENDER-PROVEN.** `knowledge/_render/verify_dv_d17_render.py`. Licensed HSBC cut asserted **inside the frame being measured**, transitions killed **before the first gesture** (ds-019's lesson, structurally), **real pointer clicks on the real gestures** (LABEL = isolate · SWATCH = check on) — never `classList.add`, which is not a user path. **Six contexts, identical:** snippet @1180/@760 · showroom **light** @1180/@760 · showroom **dark** @1180/@760 (verified genuinely dark — `--ink` `#FFFFFF`, `--line` `#808080` — so it is coverage, not one pane counted twice). **baseline** `rgb(225,225,225)` / `rgba(0,0,0,0)` → **isolated** `rgb(26,26,26)` = `--ink` + `color(srgb 0.101961 … / 0.06)` = 6% ink → **released** back to `rgb(225,225,225)` / `rgba(0,0,0,0)`.
- **★ THE FINDING — A ONE-SIDED PROOF OF AN ABSENCE IS NOT A PROOF.** The specified test was *"no `.dv-legrow` resolves the `.is-solo` treatment after isolate-then-check-on."* That is satisfied by a working fix, a blind probe, a mistyped selector **and a complete revert**. Session #8 ran it and printed `24 checks · 0 failures` while measuring nothing. **The replacement is two-sided in ONE gesture sequence: step 1 proves the treatment CAN be seen (isolate → it paints); step 2 proves it stops.** Step 1 is what makes step 2 mean anything — and it is precisely the half the original lacked. **Generalises past this defect: any proof whose assertion is "X is absent" needs a paired proof that X is detectable when present.**
- **★ THE BITE REPRODUCES DAVE'S SCREENSHOT.** `--bite` on a **neutered COPY** (216-byte DV-D17 release branch deleted; canon untouched, `git status` clean): step 2 fails at both widths with row 1 keeping `.is-solo`, `rgb(26,26,26)` border and 6% ink fill **while three series show** — the black-bordered "B Savings" Dave reported. **Step 1 still passes under the neuter**, which is the whole point: the probe is not blind, the behaviour is broken.
- **★ THE PROBE CAUGHT ITSELF, AND THE RULE IT EXERCISED IS THE ONE INSCRIBED THIS MORNING.** First run went red — *"row 2 paints an ink border with no `.is-solo`"*. **The check was working; the cause was the instrument:** `.dv-legrow:hover` also paints an ink border, and a **real** click leaves the cursor on the row it clicked. Fixed by parking the pointer **and** carrying an OBSERVED `hovered` field, so a hovered row is **named and skipped, never silently filtered**. *(A control that fires may be RIGHT — exhaust that before calling it broken. Here it was right about the pixels and wrong about the cause, and only an observed field could separate the two.)*
- **★★ ds-018 RE-VERIFIED AND IT STANDS — the timing defect did not reach it.** `knowledge/_render/recheck_ds018.py`, settled, pointer parked, 4 contexts: **`--border-disabled` → `''`** · **`--text-disabled` → `''`** · **`border-color` → `rgb(26,26,26)` = `--ink`**. ⚠ **AND IT IS WORSE THAN "DISABLED LOOKS LIKE HOVER" — THE STATES ARE INVERTED:** baseline (Reset **disabled**) → **ink border** · isolated (Reset **enabled and useful**) → `--line` · released (**disabled**) → **ink**. ⇒ **The disabled Reset is the most prominent control in the legend and the enabled one the faintest** — an inversion of affordance, not just a wrong colour. Cause unchanged (the lookup, instance five); **fix shape still Dave's**, and this adds a second cheap gate candidate: *a disabled control may not out-contrast its own enabled state.*
- **Evidence:** `python3 knowledge/_build_all.py` **60/60 GREEN exit 0** · 2026-07-27 · `verify_dv_d17_render.py` green ×6 contexts + `--bite` red ×2 widths · 2026-07-27 · `recheck_ds018.py` 4 contexts · 2026-07-27 · element renders `outputs/_render-env/png/DV-D17-three-states.png` **SEEN** (three legend states, licensed cut) · env staged from cold per `_RUNBOOK-render-verify.md`, **`__dirlock` EPERM appeared exactly as banked — a failure message after a success.**
- **⬛ NOT DONE, deliberately, and the price is stated:** no `_DECISION-HISTORY` dossier — the window ran to ~68% and inscription of the durable record was the priority over narrative. The two findings above are in the ledgers, which are the tattoos.

## ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-27 (Mon **afternoon #9**, OPUS solo self-conducting, effort MAX — ★ **ds-019 WITHDRAWN WITH CAUSE: it was NEVER a defect** · ★ **the fault was the INSTRUMENT — a computed value read in the SAME TASK as a class change is the PRE-transition value** · ★ **DV-D17's render-proof UNBLOCKED; Dave's screenshot question ANSWERED** · build untouched **60/60 GREEN**) — "A false defect spent a full session as canon, and the record was sending the next window after a rule that does not exist."

- **★ ds-019 IS NOT A DEFECT — WITHDRAWN, both beats kept.** `.dv-legrow.is-solo` **(0,2,0), cascade index 4** beats `.dv-legrow` **(0,1,0), index 3**. CDP `CSS.getMatchedStylesForNode`: no `!important`, no inline style, no `attributesStyle`, no keyframes, **no `:is()`/`:where()` list and no `#cb4-legend li` rule.** The "winning rule that does not contain the string `dv-legrow`" **does not exist** — the four-selector census was correct; its premise was false. Confirmed in **six contexts** (snippet 1180/760 · showroom light pane 1180/760 · showroom **dark** pane 1180/760, theme-tracking correctly at `--ink` `#FFFFFF` / 6% white).
- **★ THE MECHANISM — a measured time series, not a reading of CSS.** `.dv-legrow` carries `transition: border-color var(--ease), background var(--ease)` = **0.16s**. before-add `rgb(225,225,225)` / `rgba(0,0,0,0)` · **t=0 same task `rgb(225,225,225)` / `oklab(0 0 0 / 0)`** ← *exactly the pair ds-019 published as proof* · t≈50ms `rgb(145,145,145)` / `oklab(0.217785 … / 0.0241082)` (**mid-interpolation**) · **t≈150ms+ `rgb(26,26,26)` = `--ink` ✓ / `color(srgb 0.101961 … / 0.06)` = 6% ink ✓.** ⚠ **`oklab(…)` serialisation is the signature of an IN-FLIGHT INTERPOLATION, not of a failed declaration.**

## ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-27 (Mon **afternoon #8**, OPUS solo self-conducting, effort MAX — ★ **ds-018 CONFIRMED BY MEASUREMENT: it is the LOOKUP, and it is INSTANCE FIVE — a FORM-tier token consumed from a DATAVIZ-tier scope, never resolved since the day it landed** · ★ **ds-019 NEW: `.dv-legrow.is-solo` MATCHES, its vars RESOLVE, and it STILL does not paint — so DV-D17's owed render-proof is VACUOUS and would have read green forever** · ★ **MY OWN PROBE PRINTED 24 CHECKS / 0 FAILURES AND WAS WRONG** — the positive control compared computed colours as STRINGS · **NOTHING BUILT, Dave chose log-and-stop at the fork** · build unchanged **60/60 GREEN**) — "The proof was green because the thing it was watching for has never happened, and could never happen."

- **★ ds-018 — HYPOTHESIS PROVEN, COMPETING EXPLANATION ELIMINATED, BY MEASUREMENT NOT BY READING CSS** (which is what the entry demanded). `getComputedStyle` on the **disabled** Reset, licensed HSBC cut, `document.fonts.check` asserted true FIRST, **four contexts — snippet AND showroom pane (via `page.frames`), at 1180 and 760** — all four identical: **`--border-disabled` → `""` (does not resolve)** · **`--text-disabled` → `""`** · `--ink` → `#1A1A1A` (resolves, so the context is not broken) · **`border-color` → `rgb(26,26,26)` = ink = the `:hover` value** · `color` → `rgb(26,26,26)`. ⇒ IACVT → `border-color` falls to `currentColor`, `color` falls to `inherit`; **both roads end at ink.**
- **★ AND THE CENSUS IS STRONGER THAN THE MEASUREMENT: the token is not set to an ink-ish value, it is NOT SET AT ALL where a chart can see it.** `canon.css` declares `--border-disabled` **29×**, on ten **form** scopes (`.cn-input-fields` · `.cn-dropdown` · `.cn-amount-input` · `.cn-date-picker` · `.cn-date-range-picker` · `.cn-file-upload` · `.cn-form-layout` · `.cn-secure-entry` · `.cn-textarea` · `.cn-time-picker`) + their SC/dark twins — **ZERO on any chart scope, ZERO on `:root`**. The four consuming snippets (`Chart-bar`/`combo`/`donut`/`line`) declare it **0×** and use it 1× — same for `--text-disabled`. ⇒ **A FORM-TIER TOKEN READ FROM A DATAVIZ-TIER SCOPE. It has never resolved on a chart, in any theme, at any width, and every gate was green throughout.**
- **⚠ THE FIX IS WIDER THAN THE SYMPTOM DAVE REPORTED.** `--text-disabled` fails in the same breath and is **masked** (colour is inherited, so it lands on ink, which *reads* plausible) — a fix aimed only at `border-color` leaves a second silent lookup live. Belongs in the **generator + a gate**, never a `canon.css` hand-patch (block is replicated per chart family and regenerated). **Two gate candidates, neither built:** the entry's own *no control's disabled treatment may resolve to its hover treatment* · **and the cheaper, wider one — fail loud when a declaration references a custom property that resolves nowhere in its own scope** (the *fail-loud-on-unknown* shape already ratified for `dv-vocab`). ⚠ **CONFIRMED ≠ FIXED.**
- **★ ds-019 NEW — AND IT IS THE FINDING THAT STOPPED THE WINDOW.** Applying `.is-solo` **directly**, no gestures, no behaviour code: element **matches** `.dv-legrow.is-solo` ✓ · `--ink` → `#1A1A1A` ✓ · `--line` → `#E1E1E1` ✓ · yet computed **`border-color` → `rgb(225,225,225)`** (= `--line`; the declaration did not win) and **`background` → `oklab(0 0 0 / 0)` = FULLY TRANSPARENT**, not 6% ink. **Control: the identical `color-mix` written literally on a sibling `<div>` in the SAME subtree → `color(srgb 0.101961 0.101961 0.101961 / 0.06)`** — the mix itself is fine. **A rule that matches, whose variables resolve, overridden on BOTH declarations.** The census enumerated only selectors containing `dv-legrow` (4, none able to beat `(0,2,0)`) ⇒ **the winning rule does not contain that string** — `:is()`/`:where()`, `.dv-leg > li`, `#cb4-legend li`, `!important`, inline/animated all plausible, **none checked. DO NOT GUESS IT.**
- **⚠⚠ CONSEQUENCE: DV-D17's RENDER-PROOF IS UNATTAINABLE AS SPECIFIED AND WOULD HAVE READ GREEN FOREVER.** The acceptance test is *"no `.dv-legrow` resolves the `.is-solo` treatment after isolate-then-check-on"*. **No row resolves it at ANY time** — before, during, or after isolation — so the assertion is permanently true for reasons unrelated to DV-D17, **and would have survived a complete revert of the fix.** ⇒ **DV-D17 stays ENACTED · DOM-PROVEN (108/108 + 27/27, three neutered controls) · RENDER-OWED.** ⚠ **Do NOT mark it render-verified on a green run of the probe as written.**
- **⚠ A QUESTION THAT IS DAVE'S, LOGGED NOT CHASED:** if the treatment has never painted, **the screenshot behind DV-D17 showed something** — either a context not yet probed, or the treatment worked once and regressed silently. Worth knowing which.
- **★ WHAT I GOT WRONG, AND IT IS THE TRANSFERABLE PART: THE FIRST RUN PRINTED `24 checks · 0 failures` AND WAS A FALSE GREEN.** The probe carried a positive control *precisely* to stop a vacuous pass — the solo row's paint must differ from baseline or the probe is blind. **It compared computed strings.** Solo bg serialises `oklab(0 0 0 / 0)`, baseline `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)` — **textually different, visually identical (both fully transparent)** — so the control "saw a difference" and passed. **Caught BY EYE reading the JSON, not by the check.** ⇒ **Compare computed colours AS COLOURS (parse r/g/b/a), never as strings; a control that can pass on a serialisation difference is not a control.** ⚠ This happened *inside the probe written to honour* [[stale-reading-failure-mode]]'s sibling rule *"assume your probe is wrong in the direction that reads as green"* — **the rule was quoted in the file's own docstring and still did not prevent the failure it names**, because the control was checked for existence, not for sensitivity. Check the cache, proceed.**

- **★ THREE FLAGS IN, WRITTEN DOWN BEFORE ANYTHING WAS DISCUSSED.** Dave: *"I want to make changes to the charts too, I've noticed a couple of missed decisions, please note this."* Per **ds-017** (which cost the start of session #5), the placeholder went into `_DATAVIZ-DECISIONS.md` § Open/pending **at the moment of the ask**, marked `OBSERVED-BY-DAVE, contents UNSTATED` + *"do not guess which decisions he means"* — then filled in as **§ Batch 10** when he supplied them. **Nothing lived only in the chat at any point.**
- **★ DV-D16 — stacked animation. ⚠⚠ RULED, THEN REVERSED IN THE SAME WINDOW; BOTH WORDINGS KEPT.** ① *"segment by segment"* (serial hand-off) — **selected from a read-back, SUPERSEDED, do not build.** ② **IN FORCE: concurrent growth on ONE shared timeline** — Dave: *"they all grow at the same time, so they are floating and growing, rather than growing and 'handing off' to the next."* Upper segments **float** upward as the ones below grow; **per-segment easing curves, not per-segment timelines**: bottom `ease-in` · top `ease-out` · middles `linear` (the easing rule from the original ask is unchanged and is the durable part). Scope = **EVERY stacked surface**; `prefers-reduced-motion` **ships with the first enactment** (Dave: *"fine"*) — ⚠ *reduced ≠ shortened*.
- **★ THE METHOD FINDING, and it is mine not Dave's: A READ-BACK CAN ONLY OFFER ANSWERS THE ASKER THOUGHT OF.** Three tidy mutually-exclusive options *read* as a complete space and were not one; **a selection from an incomplete option set is indistinguishable from a ruling.** The instrument still earned its place — it produced the correction — but **it manufactures confidence in proportion to how well-formed the options look.** ⇒ **Standing mitigation, inscribed in the ledger: when reading back a MOTION or FEEL decision, describe the resulting SENSATION, not the mechanism.** *"The top blocks float as the bottom grows"* would have been recognised on sight; *"segment 2 starts when segment 1 lands"* was not. Sibling of [[feedback-clarify-reflect-back]] — **the reflect-back happened, correctly, and still under-determined the answer.**
- **★ DV-D18 — cap stacked segments at 6** (Dave, aligning with the donut's `dv-pie-009`), **+ ★★ FLOATED: bucketed "Other" segments must be EXPANDABLE** (*"through some mechanism we'll explore later"*, `_FUTURE-STATE.md`, unscoped by instruction). ⚠ **The two are load-bearing together — a cap with no route to the detail is data loss dressed as legibility**, and that is already the donut's live state. ⚠ **JUSTIFICATION SHIFT RECORDED, not quietly re-argued:** the cap answered a *duration* problem under serial motion; **concurrent motion dissolved that problem** (one timeline ⇒ N is free), so the cap now rests on **legibility alone**. The open duration ruling closed by ceasing to exist.
- **★ DV-D17 — RELEASE ISOLATION ENTIRELY on the second check-on.** Cause read from source, not inferred: `dv-legend.js:114/119` derive `.is-solo` from `st.isolated`, which `:129` keeps pinned while `st.focus` grows ⇒ the origin row keeps an ink border + 6% ink fill while three series show (**the screenshot**). Accepted cost, stated at ruling time: **no 2-of-5 comparison by isolate-then-add.** ⚠ **Three enactment bites named in the ledger:** restore to `visible[]` not all-on · **Reset must not self-disable while still filtered** (`:122` — *same expression ds-018 lives in, do not conflate*) · `dv-sr` must announce release on the **add** path (`:140` fires only on re-click).
- **★ ds-018 LOGGED — Reset's DISABLED state renders as its HOVER state** (Dave by eye). CSS is **correct as authored** (`:hover` already `:not(:disabled)`) ⇒ **two competing causes, and the record refuses to choose between them by reading CSS:** `--border-disabled` set to an ink-ish value (token-value bug) **vs** failing to resolve ⇒ invalid-at-computed-value-time ⇒ `currentColor` = ink (**which would be instance FIVE** of ds-010 · ds-013 · black-keys · ds-016). ⚠ **Separate them by `getComputedStyle`, snippet AND showroom, two widths. Do NOT hard-code a grey.** **Gate candidate:** *no control's disabled treatment may resolve to its hover treatment* — cheap, mechanical, and the declared-pairs contrast check can never see it because both values are legal colours.
- **⚠ MEASURED, and it changed a ruling's shape:** *"every stacked surface"* is **today a set of one** — `stacked` ×12 in `Chart-bar.reference.html`, ×0 in combo and line; stacked area unbuilt; D-Q3 promotion ruled-not-enacted. ⇒ **The broad scope costs nothing now and makes DV-D16 FORWARD-BINDING.** Carried into the chart-expansion brief or the next wave ships stacked surfaces that don't animate.
- **★ ds-012 RULED — (b) GUTTER-RELATIVE PLOT AREA.** Dave re-reported the h-bar label clipping **cold, from a screenshot, without reference to the entry that already held it measured** (*"we have cropping of the labels on the horiz-bars"*), then ruled the fix shape. **(a) fixed ~60px gutter fixes an instance; (b) fixes the class** — clipping is driven by category-name length and face looseness, **neither of which is a design property** ([[univers-measured-facts]]). ⚠ **RULED ≠ ENACTED**; 5 conditions in the entry, incl. **do not let the plot area collapse at narrow widths** (needs a floor, and the floor is Dave's eye) · **attribute the diff** — `cb2` is a REVIEWED artefact and every `x`/`width` moves · the gate (`no text.dv-label has getBBox().x < 0`) belongs with the **render-proof** family, **not** the static dataviz gate, or it is the instrument-fit error again. ⚠ **THE SECOND REPORT IS THE SIGNAL:** a logged, measured, correctly-parked defect reached the user before the queue reached it — **parking spends Dave's attention on something we already knew.**
- **Evidence:** build `python3 knowledge/_build_all.py` **60/60 GREEN exit 0** · 2026-07-27 · capture gate **14 in scope / 0 fail / 0 warn** · 2026-07-27 · source reads `knowledge/canon/dv-legend.js:114,119,122,129,140` + `canon/canon.css:3506,3531–3539` · 2026-07-27 · scope measure `grep -c stacked` over `snippets/Chart-*.reference.html` · 2026-07-27 · ds-012 figures = per-label `getBBox()` in the licensed cut, 2026-07-26, unchanged · ledger `_proforma/_DATAVIZ-DECISIONS.md` § Batch 10 · defects `knowledge/_DS-IMPROVEMENTS.md` **ds-018 NEW** + **ds-012 RULED** · floated `_FUTURE-STATE.md` § expandable "Other" · dossier `_DECISION-HISTORY/2026-07-27-the-read-back-offered-the-wrong-options.md`.
- **⬛ NOTHING ENACTED, by Dave's choice.** Priced at the fork: fill ~43% + enactment ~30% + wrap ~5% ⇒ **~78% RED**; DV-D17 alone hit the 60% boundary. The throttle's fork was put to him and **he chose FLUSH** — the first time it was used to stop work that was going *well*, which is the case it was built for. **Still open:** does the donut actually sequence today (**verify by reading the repo — do NOT ask Dave**) · ds-018's two causes · DV-D17's three bites · everything from #5 (ds-016, `CTRL` sweep, call (4), ds-017's remedy, the 15-item ruling batch).

## ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-27 (Mon **midday #5**, OPUS solo self-conducting, effort MAX — ★ **THE GAUGE IS A THROTTLE: ring-fenced ~15% reserve, every job priced, findings trigger a re-price + the fork to Dave, a new window is a REFILL, and the WEEKLY allowance is PERISHABLE** · ★ **ds-017 — the ruling was invisible to the handoff that should have carried it** · build **60/60 GREEN**; 🟡 AMBER at ritual) — "Dave had to point at the right file twice, and the reason he had to is the session's second finding."

- **★ RULED + INSCRIBED — `_RUNBOOK-context-gauge.md` § ★ Half 0b.** **(a)** discovery reserve **RING-FENCED ~15%** (sized from the observed WORST overrun, +17 — never additive; an additive term is absorbed by an optimistic plan and becomes padding) · **(b)** **any unplanned finding ⇒ STOP, re-price, fork to Dave** (log-and-stop / narrow / chase knowingly) — *"not a decision the agent makes silently from inside the sunk cost"*, which is exactly how ds-016 was chased for +17 · **(c)** **a new session is a REFILL, not a penalty** (*"we can reset the budget at any time by starting a new session"*) · **every job priced and debited**, stated when it could move the band (*"like real life"*) — **the ~10% floor is REMOVED**, every overrun on record arrived as steps each individually under it.
- **★ THE MECHANISM ALREADY EXISTED AND ITS TRIGGER WAS AT THE WRONG TIME.** Half 0's fork *is* the throttle Dave asked for; it fired **only before starting**. Extended to **two triggers**. Third instance this week of *the right rule, unreachable at the moment it is needed* (cf. ds-015, ds-016).
- **★ THE THIRD TIER — job → window → WEEK, and it INVERTS THE OBJECTIVE.** Dave's plan panel + *"the overall weekly budget, which we need to max-out or loose"*. **The window is the BUDGET; the BANK is the constraint; the cold read is a ~22% TRANSACTION FEE** on every withdrawal (measured, n=1). MEASURED 12:07 (Max 20×): week **51% elapsed · 33% used = 0.65× pro-rata · Fable 28% = 0.55×** (most under-used); 83h + 67% left ⇒ **1.36× pro-rata just to avoid losing it.** ⇒ **Behind pace = MORE WINDOWS, not longer ones**; **hoarding is now a failure too**, and **rationing Fable past the point it can be spent is waste, not discipline** ⇒ the ruling batch is the recommended next window. ⚠ **SAME-WINDOW REVERSAL, both wordings kept** — the section first read *"minimising Reds and minimising flushes are the same objective"*, which is false under a perishable allowance.
- **★ BUILT — the pre-flight FORM check in `_capture_gate.py --wrap`:** 3 terms · closing arithmetic · band matched **against the table**. **7 bites + 2 green controls** (both boundaries, 44/45 and 59/60); **bite-the-bite PASSED** — neutering the band check turns the selftest red; verified **end-to-end on the real handoff**. ⚠ **Proves the STAMP, not the RULE** — form check PROVEN, the rule UNPROVEN, and the gap is **ADR-0016's "dangerous middle"**. Declared in the module header, the runbook and the gate's own output.
- **★ ds-017 LOGGED.** `_FUTURE-STATE.md` held the ruling (★★ FLOATED, *"at the FRONT of the next window"*); **DO FIRST never carried it and instead restated the three-term rule that the same session's wrap had concluded did not work.** The 2c/2d EXIT CHECK carries §C·4 items *up* — **no clause for the inverse.** 3 remedies, UNRULED.
- **⚠ AUTHOR'S CONCERNS AGAINST HIS OWN WORK** (Dave: *"you are super clever, but agreeable… I must insist you should flag concerns"*): **15% is provisional** (n=3, one unknown, keyed off one unusual event — re-derive after ~5 sessions and RECORD each overrun) · **"unspent allowance is LOST" is `inferred` ~75%**, and sat in a canon table as fact for 20 minutes before being marked · **"1.36× pro-rata" looks like a target and targets get hit** — spending on low-value work is not a win · **the Fable recommendation was allowance-led**, though it survives on merit.
- **Evidence:** build `python3 knowledge/_build_all.py` **60/60 GREEN exit 0** · 2026-07-27 · `_capture_gate.py --selftest` **GREEN, all classes bite** · 2026-07-27 · canon `knowledge/_RUNBOOK-context-gauge.md` § ★ Half 0b · defect `knowledge/_DS-IMPROVEMENTS.md` **ds-017** · dossier `_DECISION-HISTORY/2026-07-27-the-gauge-becomes-a-throttle.md`.
- **⬛ STILL OPEN, untouched today by design:** ds-016 (3 remedies) · the `CTRL` sweep (ruled YES, not started) · call (4) · **the 15-item ruling batch — now the recommended next window (Fable)** · ds-017's remedy.

## ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-27 (Mon **later morning #3**, OPUS solo self-conducting, effort MAX — ★ **KG FORCING-FUNCTION: EXPLORATION BEAT 1 — Dave reframed it TWICE and both reframes beat the four held angles** · ★ **ds-015: `aid-009`'s hit-area check EXEMPTS every component that adopts the hit-area mechanism — 7 of 67 snippets are actually measured, gate says "0 failures"** · **PRE-FLIGHT now has THREE terms** · build **58/58 GREEN**; 🟡 AMBER ~58%, nothing built by design) — "He asked to explore, not build, so I explored. The consult's own instrument turned out to be guessing; then Dave read the exhibit and said 'maybe we are checking the wrong thing', which was righter than my exhibit — the rule is negated by the very mechanism that satisfies it."

- **★ THE HEADLINE, and it is Dave's: INSTRUMENT FIT IS A THIRD AXIS.** Angle (1) of the FLOATED idea (*compare what a rule SAYS against what its gate DEMANDS*) **would NOT have caught `aid-009`.** The rule names *"a minimum 44×44px target area"*; the gate calls its check *"target size"* — **the vocabulary matches; the narrowing is in the INSTRUMENT.** A static regex observes a *declared box*; the rule is about a *target*. They stop tracking each other the moment the property is expressed through a mechanism (expander · token · transform) — and **the gate goes QUIET, not RED.** ⇒ **Sits ON TOP of ADR-0016, not inside it:** PROVEN/CLAIMED/UNPROVEN ask *"is there a check and can it fail?"*; this asks *"is it looking at the right thing?"* — **a check can be PROVEN and still measure a proxy that doesn't track its rule.** dv-004 was the *narrowing* case; `aid-009` is the *instrument* case, and it is larger.
- **★ ds-015 — ADOPTING THE CORRECT MECHANISM IS WHAT REMOVES A COMPONENT FROM THE CHECK.** `_validate_a11y.py` does not mis-measure the `::before` expander; it **`continue`s**, deferring to a "render axis" that **does not exist** (the hit-area gate is still PENDING DAVE SIGN-OFF). **MEASURED: 67 snippets · 1,869 selectors skipped by the `CTRL` vocabulary · 14 eligible · 7 exempted · 7 actually measured.** Verdict **0 failures, exit 0**; 64 of 67 snippets use `::before`. **The diamond proves it three times** (`.dv-leg-sw.sw-diamond`, 8×8 + `rotate(45deg)`): out of `CTRL` scope · expander is `min-width:var(--hit,44px)` and the regex reads literal `(\d+)px` · `::before` → exempt. ⚠ And its real defect is a **transform** consequence — **no static box measurement can see that in principle**; `elementFromPoint` caught it by hand in the legend wave.
- **★ DAVE'S SECOND REFRAME — the propagation defect, and the strongest angle yet.** *"we are relying too much on my memory here, the hit mechanism should have triggered something that cascaded this elsewhere."* Adoption is a LOCAL CSS decision with a GLOBAL governance consequence and **nothing carried it** — no registry entry, no re-check, no flag. Sibling of the assertion-propagation gap, but worse: **the gate never fires at all, because the adoption IS the exemption.** ⇒ **The trigger should be ADOPTION-TIME, not sweep-time.** Cheapest cut: make claiming the exemption require naming the rule it exempts from, and let the register harvest it — **an exemption that must declare itself is one you can count.**
- **⚠ THE CONSULT'S OWN INSTRUMENT IS GUESSING — two defects, bite-tested.** (1) `rulings (5/5 shown, --all for more)` is **shown/CAP, not shown/total** — `:200` truncates, `:217` counts the truncated list, the true population is discarded before printing. True totals **28 · 38 · 54**; agent sees **17–22%** of the material, and **BLOCKING rules truncate too** (5 of 16). (2) `enforcement_for_rule()` decides gated-ness by **keyword overlap between rule text and gate text/glob** — it never opens the gate. **54 BLOCKING rules · consult claims a gate for 25 · 10 of those are named in no `.py` file at all.** ⚠ Stated then and now: that proves **unverified**, not **unenforced**. In fairness the docstring is candid ("possibly gated by", "answered per-query") — **it is a good hint; the defect appears only when Dave's proposal promotes the hint to an authority.**
- **★ PRE-FLIGHT NOW HAS THREE TERMS (Dave: *"remember that it self consumes tockens too"* + *"encode a pre-flight mechanism rather than loosing it in this chat"*).** The rule was already inscribed, so it was NOT re-litigated — what was missing is the **meta-cost**. ⇒ `_RUNBOOK-context-gauge.md`: **"A pre-flight estimate that does not include the wrap is not a pre-flight estimate" — `fill + job + WRAP (~5%) = projected band`, always three terms.** Consequences: **reserve the wrap BEFORE starting the job** (at Amber the question is never *"can I fit this job?"* but *"can I fit this job AND the ritual?"*) · instruments obey their own bands — **except reading the band table.** Evidence: last session priced its render job right (53%, held) then ran **the ritual unpriced**, 58→63, band corrected at close. **Applied to itself same window: the instrument-tagging build was CUT, not started.**
- **✅ ENACTED — two, both reversible, neither pre-empting a ruling.** `_validate_a11y.py`'s silent `continue` now **warns** (6→13 warnings, 0 failures) with an **anti-false-fix block**: do NOT delete the exemption and fail those selectors — they are **unmeasured**, not non-compliant, and a static parse cannot tell the difference. Plus the runbook clause above. **Nothing else built — his instruction was explore, not build.**
- **⚠ CORRECTED THE HANDOFF'S OWN PROSE IN THE FIRST TWO MINUTES.** The ★ LATEST banner said register **PROVEN 4 / UNPROVEN 52 of 76**; the generated file reads **54 of 78** — DV-D14+DV-D15 were inscribed and the register harvested them. **The RED ~63% stamp told the next reader to re-verify the prose, and it worked.** Also verified rather than inherited: **no chat-rename tool exists** (searched loaded + deferred; `session_info` is read-only) — the runbook's step-4b claim stands, re-verified.
- **Evidence:** build `_build_all.py` **58/58 GREEN exit 0** · 2026-07-27 · a11y gate **67 snippets / 0 fail / 13 warn** · 2026-07-27 · corpus scan reproducing the gate's own `CTRL`/`DECOR` regexes · 2026-07-27 · consult bite-test 3 queries default-vs-`--all` · 2026-07-27 · defect `knowledge/_DS-IMPROVEMENTS.md` **ds-015** · ideas `_FUTURE-STATE.md` § KG forcing-function **Exploration beat 1** · dossier `_DECISION-HISTORY/2026-07-27-the-instrument-cannot-see-the-property.md`.
- **⬛ FIVE CALLS ARE DAVE'S** (all in ds-015 + `_FUTURE-STATE`): (1) instrument-fit = third register axis or its own check? (2) trigger adoption-time or sweep-time? (3) run the 465-rule instrument-tagging pass? (4) fix or REMOVE the consult's enforcement column — a wrong "gated by" is worse than none; the `5/5` denominator is trivial and separable. (5) **`CTRL` is an UNSWEPT vocabulary** — the `dv-vocab` pattern applies directly and has been run nowhere but dataviz.
- **🟡 Gauge at authoring: AMBER ~58% (ESTIMATE ±15%), wrap reserved at ~5% per the new three-term rule.** Read off the band table. Nothing was built past Amber, deliberately.

records.text:
## ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-27 (Mon **later morning #2**, OPUS solo self-conducting, effort MAX — ★ **ds-014 CALLS (a)+(b) RULED BY DAVE, ENACTED AND PROVEN BY RENDER** · ★ **the gate had NARROWED ITS OWN RULE — dv-004's text is mechanism-neutral, its gate demanded a stroke** · **`dv-vocab` NEW BLOCKING: unknown chart types can no longer skip silently** · build **58/58 GREEN**; register **PROVEN 3→4, UNPROVEN 53→52**; 🟡 AMBER ~58% wrap) — "Dave declined my recommendation and asked why I'd made it. Checking cost one grep and he was right — the donut's stroke mechanism doesn't transfer to a plot with gridlines behind it. Chasing *why* I'd recommended it found the real defect: the gate had quietly narrowed a mechanism-neutral rule into one mechanism, so it wasn't just failing to catch the error, it was the source of it."

- **★ DV-D14 — dv-004 is satisfied by GEOMETRY on gridded plots (Dave's ruling, against my recommendation).** I proposed the donut's 2px `stroke="var(--page)"`. Dave: *"I prefer the geometry the border will obscure gridlines, may I know why you recommend borders?"* **He was right and the check took one grep: `cb5` carries 5 full-width `.dv-grid` lines behind the columns; the donut carries none.** An SVG stroke straddles its path, so 2px puts 1px OUTSIDE each rect — painting over every gridline down both sides of all 4 columns. ⇒ **A surface-coloured stroke only simulates separation when the thing behind it IS the surface.** Enacted **variant A, both ends pinned**: baseline `y=230` and each stack top stay TRUE, the 4px comes out of segment heights. **Accepted cost, stated at ruling time: segments understate 2.0–2.6%, worst on the shortest column.**
- **★ THE FINDING THAT OUTRANKS THE CHART — the gate had narrowed the rule.** dv-004's text is **mechanism-NEUTRAL** (*"minimum 2px separation between colour blocks"*); `_validate_dataviz.py` enforced *"must carry a surface-coloured stroke >=2px"*. Both directions bite: a chart satisfying dv-004 by real geometry **would have FAILED**, and **an agent reading the gate to learn what compliance looks like gets the wrong answer** — which is exactly what happened to me. Dave supplied the governing fact from the KG (*"the gap is only 2px minimum, this is in the dataviz specifications in the KG"*) and then named the class himself → **held as FLOATED in `_FUTURE-STATE.md`** (his exploration, do not build ahead of it). ⚠ Caution recorded there: the consult prints `rulings (5/5 shown, --all for more)` — **it TRUNCATES**, so a forcing function built on it would be a CLAIMED gate with extra steps.
- **★ DV-D15 — `data/text/on-series` MINTED (Dave's promotion).** The keys had declared `var(--page)`: white today only because of where the neutral ramp sits — **a coincidence, not an intent**. New role → `color/grey/white`, **pinned in BOTH modes**, modelled on `rag/text/on-dark`; **deliberately NO alpha channel** (DV-D07 computes contrast from the composite, so an alpha slot is a route to passing on the hex and failing on screen). **type26-013 does NOT collide** — checked, not assumed: *"black/dark-grey on light · white/light-grey on dark"* covers it; the white-only clause is specific to RED grounds.
- **★ THE VOCABULARY HAD FORKED — fixed structurally, not by enumeration.** The corpus carries **both `stacked` and `stacked-column`, both `grouped` and `grouped-column`**, plus `scatter`. Adding three strings would have guaranteed a repeat ⇒ **`DTYPE_CANON` normalises once at read time** + **`dv-vocab` (NEW, BLOCKING) fails the build on any dtype the gate has never heard of**, naming the rules that would have skipped it. Scope-blindness audit: 3 blind values → **"none detected"**. **The dataviz selftest is now WIRED into the build** — it existed and ran only by hand, which is precisely why nothing ever proved dv-004 could fail. 9 new bites, incl. one reproducing the exact ds-014 figure.
- **⚠ A THIRD SILENT-FALLBACK, and it happened AFTER the build went green.** Token minted, generated into `canon.css`, build 58/58 — **and the keys still rendered BLACK at 3.99:1.** The snippet carries a LOCAL MIRROR of the token list for standalone preview and didn't declare the new var; **`fill:var(--undefined)` falls back to the SVG initial value, black, in silence.** Third instance of one class, three different mechanisms: ds-010 (author CSS beat `fill=`) · ds-013 (404 stylesheet) · this. **Through-line: a lookup that misses and reports nothing — and in all three the markup is CORRECT, so no static gate reaches it.**
- **★ PROVEN BY RENDER — `knowledge/_verify_dv_stacked_enactment.py` (NEW, the ADR-0016 P2 proof).** Licensed cut, **snippet AND showroom pane, 1180 AND 760, all four agreeing**: separation **2.00px** on all 8 boundaries; keys white at **5.26 / 5.04 / 4.61:1** vs AA 4.5. ⚠ **The prior handoff predicted "≈5:1"; MEASURED worst case is 4.61:1** (series-3, margin **0.11**) — recorded as measured. **Series-3 cannot be lightened without breaking AA.**
- **⚠ THE PROBE COMMITTED THE ERROR IT WAS WRITTEN TO DETECT — third session running.** First run reported *"no stacked-column figure"* for the showroom; the honest reading was not "the showroom is broken" but **"I queried the top document and the panes are `srcdoc` iframes"**. Last session's probe used `querySelector('svg')` and got the toolbar copy icon. **Standing lesson, earned three times: assume your probe is wrong in the direction that reads as green.**
- **⬛ (d) donut cluster alignment — PARKED on Dave's ruling.** Logged in `_DS-IMPROVEMENTS.md`, deliberately NOT fixed; rule it in a session where he can see it live.
- **Evidence:** build `_build_all.py` **58/58 GREEN exit 0** · 2026-07-27 · gate selftest **22/22** incl. 9 new · 2026-07-27 · render proof `_verify_dv_stacked_enactment.py` **ALL ASSERTIONS PASS**, 4 contexts · 2026-07-27 · register `knowledge/_ENACTMENT-REGISTER.md` PROVEN 4 / CLAIMED 20 / UNPROVEN 52 of 76 · 2026-07-27 · ledger DV-D14 + DV-D15 · dossier `_DECISION-HISTORY/2026-07-27-the-gate-that-narrowed-its-own-rule.md`.
- **🔴 Gauge at ritual close: RED ~63% (ESTIMATE ±15%) — CORRECTED.** Banner authored at a true AMBER ~58%; the ritual cost ~5% more, crossing the Red≥60 line. Read off the band table, not recalled. **AMBER ~58%** — wrapped deliberately at Dave's "wrap up" rather than starting the remaining 52 P2 proofs hot. **Pre-flight was stated before the render job, per the new rule, and held.**

*(rolled 2026-07-27 by capture-ritual step 2d, session #6 — EXIT CHECK passed: every ⬛/⚠ item below already lives in a standing section)*

## ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-27 (Mon **later** morning, OPUS solo self-conducting, effort MAX — ★ **ADR-0016 BUILT: the ENACTMENT REGISTER** — *3 of 76 rulings (4%) are PROVEN* — **+ ds-014 DISCHARGED by render: 2 lost decisions, 2 artefacts** — build **57/57 GREEN**, register wired advisory as step 56; 🔴 RED ~92% wrap) — "Dave said 'as you advise', so: discriminator first, then the build he ruled. The discriminator settled all four of his flags in one pass. Then the register generalised the finding and put a number on the debt he had been feeling: **4%.**"

- **★ ds-014 SETTLED — measured, not argued.** Every flag rendered in the licensed cut at 1180 **and** 760, **snippet beside showroom pane** — the one pass that separates a lost decision from a ds-013 artefact. **Two are genuinely lost, two were the type outage:**
  - **#2 stacked SEGMENT SPACING — LOST.** Gap **0.0–0.1px** across all 4 columns × 3 boundaries, `stroke:none`. **dv-004 is BLOCKING and requires ≥2px.**

Fixed and gated, then the two remaining lanes landed and the transition closed."

- **★ ds-013 — LIBRARY-WIDE TYPE OUTAGE IN THE SHOWROOM, found by DAVE'S EYE.** `gen_showroom.py` delivers each snippet to its pane iframe via **`srcdoc`**, and a srcdoc document inherits the **parent's** base URL — so `<link href="../canon/type.css">`, correct from `knowledge/snippets/`, re-resolved against `showroom/` to a non-existent path. **type.css 404'd in all 49 panes that link it**; every `.t-cm-*` composite and selector binding was inert. Measured (computed styles, licensed cut): legend label **16px/400 → 12px/500**, key **→ 12px/700**. **Reset was correct only because its snippet CSS hard-codes `font-size:12px`** — the exact asymmetry Dave reported. **Longstanding, OBSERVED not inferred:** the pre-migration snippet renders **13.333px** (button UA default) under the same condition. Full record: `knowledge/_DS-IMPROVEMENTS.md` ds-013.
- **★ FIXED + GATED (`gen_showroom.py`).** `rebase_payload_urls()` re-points payload URLs; **a rebased URL whose target does not exist FAILS THE BUILD** — the condition is gated, not the instance. 6-bite `--selftest` wired as build step 56. ⚠ Anti-false-fix pinned by bite 2: an injected `<base href>` would re-base fragment URLs and **break every icon sprite in the library**. The selftest caught a genuine defect in the fix itself (dropped `?query`/`#fragment` suffixes) before it shipped.
- **★ LANES ②③ — THE WAVE IS COMPLETE.** Chart-combo (`cc1`, 2 series) + Chart-line (`cl2`, 3 series) on DV-D11. **Combo keeps ONE shape modifier** (circle, for its line series) — two mark types on one plot make shape a real non-colour channel, where bar's were dropped for being all rects. **Line earns the full circle/square/diamond set.** ⚠ **The divvy did not name this:** the diamond's `rotate(45deg)` also rotates its 44px hit-area `::before`, standing the target on its corner — **counter-rotated**, proved with `elementFromPoint` probes at 1180 and 760.
- **★ THE VERIFY SUITE WAS LYING BY CONSTRUCTION.** `_verify_dv_legend_members.js` had baked in bar's **three** series and the **literal string "Current"**; it crashed on a 2-series member and would have passed any member whose series happened to share the name. Generalised to per-N invariants with names read off the markup. **54 → 100 checks, bar's 54 unchanged.** *(Standing lesson: a suite that hardcodes one member's data cannot verify the next one — and it fails in the direction that reads as green.)*
- **★ TRANSITION CLOSED** (`_check_legend_migration.py` exit 0): transitional block deleted from `dv-behaviour.js` (**15,771 → 13,004 B**), dead `.dv-legend*`/`.dv-legbtn*`/`.dv-quiet` CSS deleted from all four members. **Page budget 31,490 → 28,723 B (88%).** ⚠ **The prior handoff predicted 85% / 27,768 B — 88% is the MEASURED figure.** Recorded as measured, per that handoff's own Correction 2.

Real fix = the already-open per-member behaviour **opt-in** (schema change, Dave's).
- **⬛ OWED → NEXT SESSION, and it is the whole point of it: the 49 changed panes have not been looked at.** Registered in `_REVIEW-SIGNOFF.md`. Dave chose "lanes now, sweep after"; the lanes consumed the window. **Build the sweep as a numeric assertion** (see `GOOD-MORNING` §DO-FIRST) — an eyeball pass authored at this gauge is the failure mode, not the mitigation.

## ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-26 (Sun evening, OPUS solo self-conducting — ★ THE CAP FORK RULED + the legend model ENACTED on its first member; build 55/55 GREEN, verify 27/27; 🔴 RED ~72% wrap) — "Opened to enact DV-D11/12/13 and hit a wall in the first ten minutes: dv-behaviour.js had 858 bytes of headroom and the model needs ~14,100. Dave ruled the deferred cap fork (§C·2 #18) — SPLIT the source AND re-scope the gate to a per-page budget — then ruled incremental migration. Chart-donut now runs the real model; bar, combo and line follow."

- **★ THE 16KB CAP FORK — RULED (§C·2 #18 CLOSED).** Measured three ways before asking: one file would land at 26,615 B as-written · 22,364 B comment-stripped · 21,327 B even with DV-D12 abandoned. None passed. Dave ruled **split AND re-scope**: `canon/dv-legend.js` joins as a second registered `$behaviour` source, the 16KB per-source cap is renamed to a LEGIBILITY constraint, and a **32KB per-GROUP PAGE budget** (`check_group`/`PAGE_BYTES`) is added so splitting can never buy headroom. Inscribed as **ADR-0015 § Amendment (2026-07-26)**, both beats. WHY/HOW: `_DECISION-HISTORY/2026-07-26-behaviour-cap-fork-and-legend-enactment.md`.
- **★ SAME DEFECT FOUND TWICE:** the "exactly ONE rAF-debounced resize listener" check was also per-source and would have failed dv-legend for carrying ZERO — correct for a source with nothing to reflow. Moved to group level under the same ruling. Gate ships **5 new selftest bites**, including the evasion case (two sources each under 16KB, together over 32KB). Selftest OK.
- **★ MINIFICATION ASKED + DECLINED (Dave, mid-build).** Numbers are real — 28,332 B raw → **9,622 B gzipped**, free at transport — but the cap is a COMPLEXITY forcing function, and minifying shrinks the number without simplifying the thing while letting source sprawl read green. Reference snippets carry the injected block inline and must stay readable; comments are the provenance trail; a minifier adds version-drift to a byte-exact `--check`. Wire-weight belongs in the ADR-0008 adapter layer. Reasoning recorded in the ADR amendment (Rejected, with reasons).
- **★ Chart-donut MIGRATED — the exemplar.** Dual-gesture rows (swatch `role=checkbox` OUTSIDE the isolate label button), typed tips (`data-tip-value`/`data-tip-percent`), sr-only live region, Reset canon-disabled (B-D4). **Verified 27/27** by `knowledge/_verify_dv_legend.js` — the REAL source driven against the REAL snippet in jsdom, incl. Dave's signed-off figures (isolate Housing 950/41%, +Savings 1250/54%), the "nothing ever hides" invariant, additive isolate, the 24%/12% ladder, and rest-to-rest sweep landing exactly on baked geometry.
- **★ TWO MISSES IN THE HANDOFF'S DIVVY, found by grep not by assumption:** (1) **the wave is FOUR members, not three** — `Chart-line` carries a legend (3 rows) and was in no lane; (2) **`.lg` COLLIDES with canon's `.seg.lg`** ("legend" vs "large") — the blast-radius gate caught it on first build; family renamed **`.dv-leg*`**. State classes `.is-ghost`/`.is-faded`/`.is-peek` KEPT — DV-D11 inscribes them verbatim.
- **★ TRANSITIONAL COEXISTENCE (Dave ruled incremental).** The two models are **selector-disjoint** (`button[data-series-toggle]` vs `.dv-legrow`), so members migrate one at a time with every commit working. The old block sits behind a marked TRANSITIONAL header with an executable end condition (`grep -l data-series-toggle knowledge/snippets/Chart-*.reference.html` returns nothing). `dv-legend`'s universal contract is **empty BY DESIGN** meanwhile, hooks riding each migrated member's extraContract, with the promotion instruction written in.
- **⚠ GATES BIT THE RESURRECTED WORK, as the rule says they should:** the signed-off v5.5 CSS failed DEF-005 (`padding:5px 9px`) and the radius gate (`border-radius:2px`). Corrected to **4px/8px** + `var(--border-radius-default)`. **Two small visual deltas from what Dave signed off — flagged for his eye, registered in `_REVIEW-SIGNOFF.md`, not buried.**
- **Build/verify:** `_build_all.py` **55/55 GREEN**; behaviour gate reports per-source 12,682 + 15,650 and page budget **31,268 B (95%)** during transition, **28,332 B (86%)** once the transitional block goes. Library 67. Seed fed (82 nodes / 146 edges).

Logged, not fudged.
- **🔴 Gauge at authoring: RED ~72% (in-head tally, ESTIMATE ±15%).** ⇒ **NEXT READER RE-VERIFY before building on this:** re-run `_build_all.py` + `node knowledge/_verify_dv_legend.js`, and spot-check the byte figures above.

On the last one: delete the transitional block, promote `class="dv-legrow` to the universal contract, drop it from the four extraContracts, re-run the gate (page budget should fall to 86%).

- **★ LEGEND FEEL RULED (Dave, supersedes the v3 'feel still the gate' line below).** Model = **click a legend item to ISOLATE that series · Reset shows all (disabled until a key is clicked)**. Because the resting state is "all shown" and a click isolates, these are **exclusive toggle-buttons (`aria-pressed`), NOT a `radiogroup`** — a radiogroup needs one persistent selection the "all" state doesn't have. The open a11y call from v1–v3 is therefore CLOSED by the chosen model.

  5. **No "only"/"Showing only X" text, no strike-through.** OFF state = box border + text muted to the **lowest grey PRIMITIVE that still passes small-text AA 4.5:1 = mono/7 `#626262` (light, 6.10:1) / mono/9 `#9D9D9D` (dark, 6.42:1)** — i.e. the existing `--data-axis`; mono/8 `#808080` FAILS both (3.95 / 4.41). Bound to a `--muted` var (= `--data-axis`). *(Dave's refinement: must be a grey in the grey primitives, not an arbitrary computed hex — so #767676/#828282 rejected in favour of the ramp step.)*

Dave ruled the design by number + ruled DV-D10 (combo labelling) by eye on a live compare sheet."

- **★ O1 (scoped inverse surface) — DESIGN RULED, inscribed as ADR-0014 addendum (Decisions 7+8).** Dave confirmed sub-decisions 1–5: naming **`data-surface="inverse"`** (extends the existing `page|raised` value set) · **re-resolution (O1)** not paired `on-*` tokens (O2) · **ink + hairlines only**, RAG/fills untouched · **always inverse-resolved, never double-inverted** (island declares itself, not "flip vs parent") · slice = donut on-segment keys + a dark card, NOT the combo. **★ VERIFIED CORRECTION to the brief:** `type26-013` ("white=red-only") is **doctrine with NO running gate** (asserted-only) — the gate that actually bites chart text is **`dv-016`** (≥3:1 vs the declared `data-surface`). So the gate work is **NOT "exempt white text"** — it is **extend `data-surface` with `inverse` + compute contrast vs the inverse ground** (white scores 4.6–5.3:1, passes with teeth intact). Stronger than an exemption; `type26-013` gets a doctrine carve-out only.
- **★ DV-D10 minted (combo/line labelling) — RULED BY EYE** on `reviews/COMBO-LABELLING-SOLUTIONS-2026-07-24-v1.html` (4 live panels + width slider). **COMBO:** drop the on-chart line-end letter; series identity → **axis-proximate legend lockups** (swatch mirrors the mark: chip=bar, line+node=line; + series name; proximity=which axis). **LINE alone:** keep the direct end-label = **shape + letter** (belt-and-braces; its end has guaranteed page-air) — the **letter is droppable** once shape+named-label present, **Dave checking his a11y team** first. Standards basis checked: dv-006 "both axes" = TOOLTIP not permanent labels · dv-011/§04.3 met by shape+text · W3C 1.4.1 + direct-labelling-preferred + the `<table>` = long-desc. **DV-D10 REMOVES the combo end-key from O1's scope.**
- **Inscribed + green:** DV-D10 → `_DATAVIZ-DECISIONS.md` (with Edges) · O1 → `ADR-0014` addendum (Decisions 7+8, full sub-decision record) · decision-graph fed (nodes DV-D10 + ADR-0014, edges; graph builds 78n/137e, my edges resolve, the 4 orphan warns are the pre-existing un-seeded ADR-0013). **`_build_all.py` 53/53 GREEN** (record-only changes: 2 ledgers + seed + ADR).
- **⬛ REMAINING = THE MECHANISM BUILD (turnkey — not yet started; a brand-gate change → wants render-verify working, per the O1 brief's own "open FRESH" note):**
  1. **Token:** mint `surface/inverse/{color, on}` in `semantic-colour.json` (DV-D07 two-channel shape) — `color` → `$alias color/neutral/4` (dark ground, theme-following = digital-black substrate) · `on` → `$alias text/on-inverse` (light ink). Keep near the `surface/*` block (~line 2588).
  2. **Cascade:** a scoped rule `[data-surface="inverse"]{ --ink: <on>; --baseline/hairlines: <on/muted>; }` in `canon.css` — find the HAND-AUTHORED cascade home (near the `[data-theme]` blocks, NOT between AUTO markers). Ink + hairlines only; leave series/RAG/dataviz vars alone.
  3. **Gate:** in `_validate_dataviz.py`, when a `dv-label`/`dv-axis`/`dv-key` text node is inside a `data-surface="inverse"` context, set its `surface_key` to the inverse ground (add `--inverse` to the resolved theme vars) so dv-016 checks against the right base + **add a selftest bite** (white-on-inverse passes, dark-ink-on-inverse fails). Record the `type26-013` doctrine carve-out in the guideline.
  4. **Apply:** donut on-segment keys (`Chart-donut` `text.dv-key-el fill="var(--ink)"` → sit in `data-surface="inverse"`) + **rebuild `Chart-combo` legend as the two axis-proximate lockups + strip `.dv-endkey`** (DV-D10). `Chart-line` keeps its end-key pending Dave's a11y check. Regen cascade+showroom.
  5. **Verify:** `_build_all.py` 53/53 + **render-verify light+dark @2 widths** (clears the standing OWED — brand-gate change deserves the look).
- **★ SCOPE NARROWED BY DAVE (2026-07-24 PM):** **line + sparkline are DONE** (no O1, no DV-D10 change — line keeps its end-key, letter-drop parked on the a11y check). **Work = DONUT + BAR** (+ combo's end-key→lockups, already scoped). Per-chart worklist:
  - **Donut:** O1 `inverse` on the 6 on-segment keys (`dv-key-el fill=var(--ink)`) + the new legend. (D-Q2 spider-vs-direct still Dave's open.)
  - **Bar:** ⚠ VERIFY the 12 `dv-barkey` letters on the grouped column (cb4) — on the dark fill or in page air? If on-fill → O1 `inverse` or nudge to page air (the compare-sheet rule: bars keep keys adjacent). + the new legend.
  - **Combo:** drop `.dv-endkey` → two axis-proximate lockups (chip=bar, line+node=line) + the new legend.
  - **Cross-cutting:** the LEGEND REDESIGN rides `dv-behaviour.js` (one shared edit) + per-snippet legend markup on bar/combo/donut (NOT line/spark).
- **★ LEGEND REDESIGN — interactive prototype BUILT, Dave to rule the FEEL:** `reviews/LEGEND-ISOLATE-TOGGLE-PROTOTYPE-2026-07-24-v1.html` (grouped bar + donut, live). Model: **swatch = checkbox (additive on/off) · label = isolate (exclusive, radio-FEEL; click active again = show all)**. State logic node-tested (isolate→additive-clears-solo→re-isolate→restore-all; can't hide last visible — all assertions pass). **ONE OPEN A11Y CALL for Dave (annotated in-sheet):** isolate built as exclusive **toggle-buttons** (`aria-pressed`) not a true `radiogroup` — because an additive multi-state has no single "checked" radio. Radiogroup gives arrow-scrub feel but the multi-state quirk. **Dave rules by feel, THEN the wave builds.**
- **🔴 Gauge at authoring: RED ~65% (ESTIMATE ±15%) — HOT. Dave called the handover: "were obviously hot… there are silly mistakes."** ⇒ **NEXT READER: re-verify this session's claims before building on them.** The RECORD-ONLY inscriptions (DV-D10, ADR-0014 addendum, graph, build 53/53) are Dave-ruled + build-verified green = trustworthy. The **two review sheets are ROUGH** (the compare sheet had a month-label overlap render bug; the legend prototype's *interaction* logic tested clean but its *visuals/chart geometry* were NOT render-verified and Dave flagged "silly mistakes"). **Dave's instruction: "go back a step and do this again in the next sesh, be very careful."** So the next window RE-DOES the legend prototype + the wave carefully, with render-verify RUNNING.

- **★ ADR-0013 BUILT end-to-end (the clean-room, same-day follow-on from the morning's ADR-0014).** The RULE half of retrieval is live: **(1) Registry** `knowledge/component-types.json` — ONE file, both halves: path-addressable token store (`component-type/button-family/{press-travel,press-darken}`, $alias→`motion/press/*` + cached $value, the full alias hop component→type-group→semantic wired through `gen_theme_cascade`'s alias map) + `$members` (selector map per consumer) + `$partials` (source atom, rootSelector, requires-vars/matchValues/declarations contracts, manifest-bind contracts). **(2) `gen_component_partials.py`** — extracts the atom's `PARTIAL` block, selector-rewrites (word-boundary safe: `.btn`→`.nav button`/`.iconbtn`), injects with provenance comment between consumers' `AUTO-PARTIAL` markers; `--check` = build gate (fails loud, manual regen preserves attribution); selftest 8 bites incl. the EMPTY-adjacent-marker case (real bug caught live: the first regex couldn't see a fresh migration's empty pair). **(3) `_validate_partials.py` ratchet** (radius-gate pattern): press-physics-shaped CSS (:hover/:active + transform scale/translate) only inside marked blocks — STRICT on members' mapped selectors (0 fails), CENSUS 32 rules = the observed-duplication accretion worklist (`_PARTIALS-GATE.md`). **(4) `gen_canon_components` wired into `_build_all`** (ruling 4): regenerate-always (write step — snippet RULE-text self-heals into canon) + determinism `--check`; build **45→51**, all green.
- **★ B-D7 RULED + ENACTED (Dave, mid-build — the reversal IS the ruling; ledger `_BUTTON-DECISIONS.md` B-D7, seed fed same hour 124/124 zero mismatch).** First beat: "switch to the shared 4%". Reversed within the hour: *"the movement in the icon button (its more subtle) is the one that should propagate to everything in console and Mono"* + *"the movement should be absent from Legacy and Supercharge, just colour change"* + *"as long as we don't use any js we may tune later."* Enacted: **travel is PIXEL-TRUE** — `motion/press/travel` (2px of size change) + `motion/press/darken` (0.94), expressed `scale(calc(1 ± travel/var(--phys-size)))` with `--phys-size` = LOCAL geometry (buttons 120, icon button 44 — the Tranche-1 size-scoping; Icon-button's resolved values stay byte-identical to its reviewed originals). **Motion = THEME DIAL:** Legacy + SC override sets carry `travel→0, darken→1` (identity transforms; colour tokens alone carry state) — verified in the cascade at every tier (root vars + group cache + all 4 member component re-projections, both themes). Console INHERITS Mono's motion (NOT added to the ADR-0014 locked fence — that was ruled for colour; **flag RULED closed same day, Dave: "Console and mono can share the motion tokens for now" — inheritance, not fence**). Everything CSS custom properties + calc — zero JS (DEF-003 posture). Supersedes Button's promoted 2026-06-22 factor VALUES; the rule shape survives.
- **Proof migrations complete (4/4):** Button = source atom (PARTIAL block, its old global reduced-motion `.btn` line moved INSIDE the partial per ruling 3) · Modals = injected (copied physics deleted) · **Progress-tracker** = translateY(1px) evicted + the **queued responsive-stepper collapse FOLDED IN** (ADR-0013 Consequences): wide containers = the DOTS stepper resurrected from canon@`273d18c~1` (tokens rebound — done-dot = `progress/complete` ink pair + `text/on-inverse` check, real glyph `status-icons/yes.svg` byte-matched; weight 600→500 per brand; connector 3px/13px → 4px/12px after the **grid gate bit the resurrection** — DEF-005 doing its job on pre-gate-era CSS) · ≤520px container = the 1784-86051 head+track form · persistent sr-only aria-live + aria-current=step · **Icon-button** = injected, visually UNCHANGED (its model became the canon). **Exit gate passed BOTH halves:** value dial 2→6 → four consumers moved (both modes each), reverted clean; source rule-text probe → three consumers moved, reverted clean.
- **ds-008 + ds-009 CLOSED (`_DS-IMPROVEMENTS.md`):** radius census strips HTML comments (+bite case); consult corpus now DISCOVERED — globs `_proforma/_*-DECISIONS.md`, generic `[A-Z]{1,3}-D\d+` ID regex, a zero-yield ledger FAILS the build (stronger than the specced selftest — runs every build). Verified live: B-D2/4/6 surface on a consult query.
- **🐛 What I got wrong / caught:** the empty-marker regex bug (caught by the live run, fixed + selftest case added); the resurrected stepper carried off-grid 13px/3px (grid gate caught it — resurrect-verbatim is not exempt from current gates); first B-D7 answer was inscribed-in-flight as "flatten" before Dave's reversal — recorded BOTH beats in the ledger so the reversal can't read as drift. **Render-verify still OWED** (headless-shell refusal unchanged from the morning session; verification stood on gates + the two exit-gate mechanical proofs; Dave reviews live HTML).
- **POST-WRAP ADDENDA (same afternoon, Dave in-chat):** **(1) Console motion flag CLOSED** — *"Console and mono can share the motion tokens for now"* → inheritance, not fence (committed `0eb0f9e`). **(2) Theme posture:** **Legacy frozen** ("shouldn't change"); **Mono + Supercharge + Console all in design development.** **(3) ★ BUTTON-STATES FINESSE PASS QUEUED** (his explicit "not now but note for a follow up") — Legacy mechanism fidelity question (as-built may be OPACITY-based vs our explicit colours — verify against source) · Mono/Console pressed needs a DARKER pressed fill (ties to the open tert/quat pressed-token gap + B-D7's softer darken) · SC keeps the opacity option open (probably won't change) · **loader ATOM for all loading states** (registry group candidate #2). - **★ ADR-0013 ACCEPTED (Dave, in-chat; his stated principle: "correctness, solid build, flexibility and best practice rather than expedience").** Four firm rulings: **(1)** composition mechanism lands BEFORE Phase-2 fan-out. **(2)** Mechanism = **generated partials** — atoms declare named rule-blocks; generator injects into consuming snippets between AUTO-PARTIAL markers (provenance comment per block); `--check` sync gate; **ratchet-style gate** (census→advisory→blocking, the radius pattern) fails the build on local re-implementation of a registered partial. Runtime class-sharing REJECTED inside the KB (source-of-truth inversion: snippets would consume generated canon) — that's the ADR-0008 adapter-boundary pattern; the component machine stays the horizon, partials are its parts bin. **(3)** **One registry, both halves:** `knowledge/component-types.json` — group → members + parameter tokens + rule partials; resolution adds ONE hop to the alias chain (component → type-group → semantic role → default, `gen_theme_cascade` already alias-aware); first population = `button-family` motion tokens lifted from the local `--btn-grow`/`--btn-press` (zero visual change in Mono; reduced-motion rides INSIDE the partial); groups accrete from OBSERVED duplication only; every new gate ships a selftest. **(4)** **`gen_canon_components` joins `_build_all`** — regenerate-always + `--check`, same contract as every projector (closes Phase-1's silent-divergence finding). Record: `docs/decisions/ADR-0013-component-type-tier-composition.md`; `_FUTURE-STATE` tiered-flex entry GRADUATED → ADR-0013.
- **Survey ground truth (the case, quantified this session):** 13/40 snippets carry a local button recipe · 7 carry Button's scale-press by copy · 4 press with `translateY(1px)` — already-drifted physics (Selection-controls carries BOTH in one file). The unlock: **T-D9/T-D12 already solved rule-sharing for TYPE** (composites + selector-list bindings + blast-radius gate) — partials are the box-side twin, and Dave's queued flex tier is where their VALUES live. One architecture question, as the handoff suspected.
- **ds-009 logged (`_DS-IMPROVEMENTS.md`), found via Dave's mid-flight question:** the CONSULT corpus omits `_BUTTON-DECISIONS.md` — B-D1…B-D5 unfindable by any query (index is FRESH, rebuilt every build; the gap is corpus membership). Fix queued into the ADR-0013 session: corpus add + selftest asserting every `_proforma/_*-DECISIONS.md` on disk is indexed.
- **Context-gauge Half 2 BROKEN in this env (warning inscribed in `_RUNBOOK-context-gauge.md`):** the out-of-band subagent measured the WRONG session (live session unidentifiable in `list_sessions`) AND `read_transcript` strips tool results (13KB stub for a session bigger than that in receipts alone) — then rationalised the bad number. **Half 1 in-head tally governs until rebuilt.** Wrap fired at mid-Amber (~52%) by agreement — "author the handoff while quality is intact".
- **Ruling batch §C·1 NOT run** (moved by the gauge call). **NEXT, SERIAL: (a) ruling-batch window (Opus, short)** — Console radius px · Legacy fidelity-vs-AA ×2 · pro-forma fold-or-keep · `tabs/active` · bigplay eyeball, then the enact-queue (F1/F2/F5/tag-atom/designer-pack v2.1); **(b) ADR-0013 clean-room (Fable solo, fresh full budget, serial — Phase-0 precedent)** — registry + partial generator + gates(+selftests) + `gen_canon_components` wiring + ds-008/ds-009 + proofs Button→Modals→Progress-tracker (Back/Next press VISIBLY changes translateY→scale: Dave eyeball)→Icon-button; exit gate = change a factor once in Button, every consumer moves; **(c) Phase-2 fan-out** (conductor + 2 Fable workers) inherits the mechanism. Then flip `_validate_theme_provenance.py` to blocking.


- **★ LIVE — the FOUR THEMES are now wired as an architecture, not just intent (ADR-0011).** `docs/decisions/ADR-0011-four-theme-token-architecture.md`: themes = **override sets at the semantic tier** (Mono = base · Legacy = populated override · Console + Supercharge = **declared nullable slots**, ADR-0010). Registry `tokens/themes/_themes.json` = single source of truth for which hex belongs to which theme. Mechanises R-D15. **Root cause found:** the token store had NO theme dimension — only light/dark modes — so Legacy red + Mono lived in the same flat roles (`primary/*`=#DB0011, `tabs/active`, `progress/complete`, bare `rag/error`). That is why "align to Mono" was "too loose" (Dave).
- **★ LIVE — RULING R-D19: red belongs to a THEME.** Legacy red `#DB0011`/`#A8000B` = Apollo **Legacy only** (CTA, tabs, progress, Legacy error). Apollo **Mono's only red = `#B92F1E`**, used **only** for status/RAG + dataviz (never action/nav). Any Legacy red in a Mono surface = **drift**. Source: Dave ("these reds are valid for legacy only, we have a new red for mono, only used for status and RAG"). Ledger `_proforma/_RAG-DECISIONS.md`.
- **★ LIVE — THE RECORD: `knowledge/_STYLE-PROVENANCE.md`** (Dave's ask — "clear record … don't miss this in future"). (v1 COMPARE = first cut, superseded.)

Flags **hardcoded** foreign-theme hexes in Mono surfaces — the blind spot the token leak gate can't see. First run: **68 hardcoded Legacy hexes across 61 Mono files** → `_THEME-PROVENANCE-GATE.md`. Advisory now; **promote to blocking after the migration** (ADR-0011).

### ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-20 (evening) — "Mono primary-action token + ADR-0009 state-styling architecture (live-editor loop)"
- **★ LIVE — the OWED mono primary-action ruling is CLOSED (commit `b895c40`, build green 35/35).** `button/primary/*` minted, completing the button ladder: component → semantic (`surface/action-primary{,-hover,-pressed}`, `icon/on-inverse`, `text/on-disabled`) → `color/mono/*`. **Monochrome — NO red** (red is out of bounds for Mono, not merely Legacy-only; ruling B-D1). Settled values (Dave, dialed on the v7 live editor): default `#1A1A1A`/`#FAFAFA` · hover **opacity 0.70** operational + colour-equivalent `#626262`/`#B7B7B7` stored · pressed `#000000`/`#FFFFFF` · disabled fill `#E1E1E1`/`#484848`, label `#9D9D9D`/`#808080`.
